# Sollari

Sollari builds e-commerce apps, company portfolio websites, mobile apps and custom web platforms.

## Stack

Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), Rust, Next.js, React, Astro, Django.

## Selected work

- Door2Door, skincare e-commerce across Nepal: https://door2door.sollari.app/en/door2door-nepal
- Oji International Language Center: https://ojiintl.com/
- Asia Dialogue Initiative: https://asiacan.sollari.app/

## Contact

Use the contact form on the homepage: https://www.sollari.app/#contact

## Pricing

- Company websites: NPR 4,000 per year plus domain cost (built to your needs, deployed and hosted).
- E-commerce, mobile and custom software: priced per project after agreeing the scope.
